content:
The total number of students is 20.  
20% enrolled in contemporary dance: \(20\% \times 20 = 4\) students.  
Remaining students: \(20 - 4 = 16\).  
25% of the remaining enrolled in jazz: \(25\% \times 16 = 4\) students.  
The rest enrolled in hip-hop: \(16 - 4 = 12\) students.  
Percentage of entire class in hip-hop: \(\frac{12}{20} \times 100\% = 60\%\).

Answer: 60%
